about_short_description.short_description: Pine Park Health sends doctors and nurse practitioners into senior living communities to see patients at home

identifier.value: In-Home Primary Care

product.name: In-Home Primary Care
product.description: Primary care delivered in patients’ homes within senior living communities by board-certified physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician associates.

identifier.value: Preventive Care and Health Screening

product.name: Preventive Care and Health Screening
product.description: Preventive services that help identify health risks and support long-term wellness, including screenings, vaccinations, health planning, nutrition, and exercise counseling.

identifier.value: Rapid Care

product.name: Rapid Care
product.description: In-home evaluation and treatment for common urgent health concerns, including minor injuries, infections, falls, respiratory symptoms, and other non-emergency needs.

identifier.value: Chronic Condition Care and Specialist Coordination

product.name: Chronic Condition Care and Specialist Coordination
product.description: Ongoing management of chronic and complex conditions with personalized care planning, specialist referrals, testing, and communication across the patient’s care team.

identifier.value: Medication Management

product.name: Medication Management
product.description: Medication review and coordination to improve medication safety, simplify prescriptions, manage refills and side effects, and align treatment with patient goals.

identifier.value: Mental Wellness Care

product.name: Mental Wellness Care
product.description: Primary-care-based support for common mental and emotional health concerns, including anxiety, depression, grief, loneliness, insomnia, stress, and substance use.
